s1.syndrome_frame: Ocular inflammation with eyelid involvement and conjunctival hyperemia in a patient with a history of inflammatory bowel disease
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse

raw.syndrome_frame: Ocular inflammation with eyelid involvement and conjunctival hyperemia in a patient with a history of inflammatory bowel disease
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse

differentials: congenital melanocytic kissing nevus on right eyelid

raw.rationale: The presence of bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids, crusty plaques on the eyelid margins, and diffuse conjunctival hyperemia are key findings that support a diagnosis of conjunctivitis.

rejected.label: inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of Crohn disease, the current symptoms are localized to the eyes and do not directly relate to the gastrointestinal system.

rejected.label: ectropion
rejected.why: Ectropion is a symptom rather than a diagnosis, and it is mentioned as a finding in the context of the patient's eyelid involvement.

rejected.label: uveitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of uveitis-specific symptoms such as pain, photophobia, or decreased visual acuity, and the rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable.

rejected.label: scleritis
rejected.why: Scleritis typically presents with severe eye pain, redness, and tenderness, which are not mentioned in the case description.
